item.title: Navigating Lubbock's Frustrations: Wind, Traffic, And More
item.description: From Lubbock's relentless winds to unexpected shopping detours, daily annoyances remind residents to keep their spirits high.

item.title: Not So Sweet. Texas Tech Falls To Alabama in the NCAA Tournament
item.description: Texas Tech bounced from the NCAA Tournament.

item.title: Big News For Texas Tech: $5M In New Grants Awarded
item.description: Texas just dropped $5 million to help nine institutions train the next generation of forensic psychiatrists! See which medical centers are getting a boost to their mental health programs.

item.title: Lubbock Firefighting Hero Beats Cancer, Here's How
item.description: After 30 years of service, Lubbock Fire Lt. Brett Assiter was saved by the very program designed to protect him. His story shows why early cancer detection is a game-changer for our local first responders.

item.title: SHOCKING! Lubbock Police Arrest Four Teenagers For Allegedly Breaking Into 30 Vehicles in One Night
item.description: Three juveniles and one adult, all teenagers, are accused of breaking into and vandalizing at least 30 vehicles.

item.title: Challenge Of Champions Brings Backyard Games To Fast Eddie's This Sunday In Lubbock
item.description: This weekend, Lubbock's Fast Eddie's will host the Challenge of Champions, mixing backyard and bar games for a fun competition, all while supporting mental health resources for local service workers.

item.title: Springtime In Lubbock Means Extra Caution For Pedestrians And Cyclists On Busy Loop 289
item.description: As spring blooms in Lubbock, TxDOT reminds drivers to watch for pedestrians and cyclists, who are increasingly at risk on busy roads like Loop 289. Stay safe out there!

item.title: Things You Only See in Lubbock (And Somehow Think Are Normal)
item.description: Life in Lubbock is full of surprises, from horses at the store to Ghostbusters cars and mariachi bands, making the ordinary feel wonderfully quirky.

item.title: Thousands in Lubbock, West Texas, and the Panhandle Could Lose In-Network Insurance Access
item.description: Latest announcement from TTUHSC and Texas Tech Physicians could have a big impact.

item.title: Lubbock's Unwritten Dress Code: From Pajamas To Pearls
item.description: Lubbock's fashion scene blends casual comfort with moments of formality, from grocery store pajamas to stylish church outfits, capturing the community's unique vibe and spirit.
